exercises.explanationUz:
NORASMIY XAT - YoZGI REJALAR.


⚠ 5-UNIT GRAMMATIKASI XATDA:

  'be going to' - REJALAR:
    "I'm going to relax", "I'm going
     to join", "I'm going to visit"
  present continuous - KELIShILGAN:
    "I'm going on holiday in June"
    "She's getting married on 29th
     August"
  'will' - VA'DA/TAXMIN:
    "I'll let you know", "I'll send
     you a postcard"


⚠ NORASMIY XAT BELGILARI:

  'Dear Ann,' (ism bilan)
  qisqartmalar ("I'm", "I've")
  'Well, that's all for now.'
  'Best wishes,'

tasks.en: [Para 1] Dear Ann, Thanks a lot for your letter. You're going to have a great summer, it seems. Your plans sound fantastic.
tasks.uz: [1-xatboshi] Aziz Ann, xating uchun katta rahmat. Ko'rinishidan, yozing zo'r o'tadi. Rejalaring ajoyib eshitiladi.

tasks.en: [Para 2] I've got a lot of plans for the summer, too. Firstly, I'm going to relax for a while because I'm very tired, then I'm going to have some fun! I'm going on holiday with my friend in June. We're going to spend two weeks in exotic Hawaii!
tasks.uz: [2-xatboshi] Menda ham yozga ko'p rejalar bor. Birinchidan, biroz dam olaman, chunki juda charchaganman, keyin zavqlanaman! Iyunda do'stim bilan ta'tilga ketyapman. Ekzotik Gavayida ikki hafta o'tkazamiz!
tasks.note:
⚠ "I'm going to relax" - reja.
⚠ "I'm going on holiday in June" - present
continuous: kelishilgan.
⚠ 'to have fun' = zavqlanmoq.

tasks.en: When we come back, I'm going to join my local drama group because, as you know, I want to become an actress one day. I'll let you know when the first performance is, so you can come and watch.
tasks.uz: Qaytganimizda mahalliy drama to'garagiga qo'shilaman, chunki bilasan, bir kun aktrisa bo'lishni xohlayman. Birinchi spektakl qachonligini senga aytaman, kelib tomosha qilasan.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'When we COME back' - present simple.
⚠ "I'll let you know" = senga aytaman (va'da).
⚠ 'a performance' = spektakl, chiqish.

tasks.en: At the end of the summer, I'm going to visit my sister in LA. She's getting married on 29th August. Isn't that fantastic?
tasks.uz: Yoz oxirida Los-Anjelesdagi opamnikiga boraman. U 29-avgustda turmushga chiqyapti. Ajoyib-a?
tasks.note:
⚠ "She's getting married ON 29th August" -
aniq sana → present continuous.
⚠ 'LA' = Los Angeles.
⚠ "Isn't that fantastic?" - hayajon.

tasks.en: [Para 3] Well, that's all for now. I'll send you a postcard from Hawaii. Have a great summer! Best wishes, Nicola
tasks.uz: [3-xatboshi] Xo'sh, hozircha shu. Gavayidan otkritka yuboraman. Yozing zo'r o'tsin! Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan, Nicola
tasks.note:
⚠ "that's all for now" - norasmiy xat tugashi.
⚠ "I'll send" - va'da.
⚠ 'Best wishes' - norasmiy yakun.

OLDINGI VOQEA → PAST PERFECT.


JAVOBLAR:

  1 The chef HAD PREPARED the food by
    the time the guests ARRIVED.
  2 When I CAME home, I saw that she
    HAD ALREADY DONE the shopping.
  3 The war HAD ENDED when Jim BEGAN

  4 She HAD JUST ENTERED her house
    when the earthquake STARTED.
  5 He HAD JUST PUT the phone down
    when it RANG again.


⚠ 'AN EARTHQUAKE':

  = zilzila.
  ⚠ 'earth' + 'quake' (tebranish).


⚠ 'TO PUT THE PHONE DOWN':

  = go'shakni qo'ymoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the correct tense. (5 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni to'g'ri zamonga qo'ying. (5 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
1-TUR ShART GAPLARI VA VAQT
SO'ZLARI (38, 47-betlar).

  if/when + PRESENT SIMPLE,
  will + fe'l


JAVOBLAR:

  1 If I SEE Tom, I'll tell him.
  2 What WILL YOU DO if you win?
    (asosiy gap → will)
  3 If he FAILS the test, he'll be
    in trouble.
  4 She WILL HELP us if she has
    enough time. (asosiy gap → will)
  5 When she COMES back, she'll tell
    us.


⚠ 2 va 4-BANDLAR:

  'if' bo'lagi EMAS, ASOSIY gap →
  'will'.
  ⚠ 'What will you do IF you WIN' -
  'win' present simple, 'will do'
  asosiy.


⚠ 'TO FAIL':

  = yiqilmoq (imtihonda).
  ⚠ 'fails' - 3-shaxs '-s'.

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the dialogues with phrases from the list. (6 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Dialoglarni ro'yxatdagi iboralar bilan to'ldiring. (6 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI DIALOG.


a) NAVBAT OLISh (38-bet):
  A: Good morning. COULD I see Mr
     Harris, please?
  B: I'M AFRAID not. He's in a
     meeting. WOULD YOU like to make
     an appointment?
  A: Yes, please.


b) TEZ OVQAT RESTORANI (43-bet):
  A: CAN I help you?
  B: Yes. Can I have a club sandwich,
     please?
  A: Certainly. DO YOU want anything
     to drink?
  B: A Diet Coke, please.
  A: Anything else?
  B: No thanks. HOW MUCH is that?
  A: That's £3.20.


⚠ "I'M AFRAID NOT":

  = afsuski yo'q.
  ⚠ "I'm afraid so" = afsuski ha.


⚠ '£3.20':

  = 'three pounds twenty'.


⚠ 'IN A MEETING':

  = yig'ilishda.

REJA (Nicola xati bo'yicha):

  Para 1: Greeting - rahmat, do'st
     rejalari haqida
  Para 2: Plans - o'z rejalaring
     (be going to / present
      continuous / will)
  Para 3: Conclusion - xayrlashish


⚠ 'TOTAL: 100 marks' - butun test

tasks.en: Dear Ann, Thanks a lot for your letter. It was great to hear from you. Your summer plans sound really exciting!
tasks.uz: Aziz Ann, xating uchun katta rahmat. Sendan xabar olganim juda yaxshi bo'ldi. Yozgi rejalaring juda qiziqarli eshitiladi!

tasks.en: I've got a lot of plans for the summer, too. Firstly, I'm going to stay at home and rest for a week. Then I'm going to the mountains with my family in July. We're going to spend ten days there. When we come back, I'm going to take a computer course because I want to learn programming. At the end of August, I'm visiting my grandparents in the village. I'll help them in the garden.
tasks.uz: Menda ham yozga ko'p rejalar bor. Birinchidan, bir hafta uyda dam olaman. Keyin iyulda oilam bilan toqqa boraman. U yerda o'n kun o'tkazamiz. Qaytganimizda kompyuter kursiga boraman, chunki dasturlashni o'rganmoqchiman. Avgust oxirida qishloqdagi buvi-bobomnikiga boraman. Ularga bog'da yordam beraman.

tasks.en: Well, that's all for now. I'll send you some photos from the mountains. Have a great summer! Best wishes, Aziz
tasks.uz: Xo'sh, hozircha shu. Senga tog'dan suratlar yuboraman. Yozing zo'r o'tsin! Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan, Aziz
